name: effort-cycle-is-refused-for-an-acp-harness
description: In built-in mode with an ACP agent as the harness, Cycle Effort says the harness has no effort setting and changes nothing: no restart, no stop.
reason: Effort changes by relaunching the Claude CLI with --effort and --resume. An ACP agent has no such flag and cannot resume, so restarting it would only lose the conversation for nothing.

transcript.text: This harness doesn't have an effort setting.
